name: Expo & React Native Performance and Architecture Rules
description: Rules for thread performance, Continuous Native Generation (CNG), code cleanliness, and UI/UX standards.

THREAD_PERFORMANCE.title: Thread Performance & Lag Reduction
THREAD_PERFORMANCE.description: Rules to preserve 60/120 FPS on the UI thread and prevent JavaScript thread blockage.

EXPO_CNG.title: Expo Continuous Native Generation (CNG)
EXPO_CNG.description: Rules enforcing config plugins, clean prebuild workflows, and dependency hygiene.

CODE_CLEANLINESS.title: React Native Code Cleanliness & Architecture
CODE_CLEANLINESS.description: Rules enforcing modularity, small files, typing, and zero production log noise.

UI_UX_STANDARDS.title: UI & Design Token Standards
UI_UX_STANDARDS.description: Rules ensuring design token consistency, accessibility touch targets, and visual polish.

rules.name: NO_PAN_RESPONDER
rules.description: PanResponder processes touch gestures on the JavaScript thread, creating frame drops and input lag when the JS thread is busy.
rules.recommendation: Use 'react-native-gesture-handler' paired with 'react-native-reanimated' to execute gesture handling on the native UI thread.

rules.name: AVOID_INLINE_STYLES_IN_MAP
rules.description: Inline style objects (style={{ ... }}) allocated inside .map() callbacks create fresh object references on every render, triggering avoidable GC pressure and subcomponent re-renders.
rules.recommendation: Extract styles into StyleSheet.create outside the component or memoize dynamically calculated style values.

rules.name: UNBOUNDED_MAP_RENDERING
rules.description: Rendering dynamic lists using array.map() renders all items at once into the layout tree without virtualization, leading to memory bloat and scroll stutter.
rules.recommendation: Use virtualized list components such as FlatList or @shopify/flash-list with keyExtractor and getItemLayout for large or dynamic collections.

rules.name: NO_MANUAL_NATIVE_DIRECTORIES
rules.description: Directly committing or manually modifying 'android/' or 'ios/' directories bypasses Expo Continuous Native Generation (CNG), causing drift and upgrade friction.
rules.recommendation: Configure native permissions, bundle identifiers, and build settings via app.json config plugins. Native directories should be generated dynamically or gitignored.

rules.name: EXPO_INSTALL_DEPENDENCIES
rules.description: Directly installing native packages via standard npm or yarn can install binary versions incompatible with the active Expo SDK release.
rules.recommendation: Always install native modules using 'npx expo install <package>' to maintain version compatibility with the active Expo SDK.

rules.name: NO_CONSOLE_LOG
rules.description: console.log and console.debug statements serialize objects synchronously across the bridge and leak sensitive diagnostics in production builds.
rules.recommendation: Remove console.log/console.debug before merging or guard them behind a __DEV__ condition or a dedicated logger utility.

rules.name: MAX_FILE_LINE_COUNT
rules.description: Files exceeding 250 lines of code increase cognitive load, complicate code reviews, and violate the single responsibility principle.
rules.recommendation: Decompose large components into subcomponents, extract business logic into custom hooks (src/hooks/), and isolate data queries into services (src/services/).

rules.name: NO_HARDCODED_HEX_COLORS
rules.description: Hardcoded hex color strings (#hex) in components bypass centralized design tokens and break theming consistency.
rules.recommendation: Import palette colors from 'src/theme' (e.g., colors.primary, colors.background) instead of hardcoding raw hex values in components.

rules.name: MIN_TOUCH_TARGET_SIZE
rules.description: Interactive elements with touch targets smaller than 48x48 dp harm accessibility and usability on touch screens.
rules.recommendation: Provide hitSlop or ensure interactive elements have a minimum height and width of 48dp.
